_comment: D2 extractor-output guard (tests/surface.test.ts). Scope, honestly: this guard covers schema.ts-layer changes (manifest, TS registerTool, Python @mcp.tool rungs, one extractSchema call per file since the ladder stops at the first non-empty rung). Sampler (selectRepoFiles) changes are caught by tests/fixtures/sampling-corpus.json instead. If the guard fails and the change is intentional, bump EXTRACTOR_VERSION in src/derive/surface.ts and re-record with the one-off script from the D2 plan, updating this fixture in the same commit.
